title: In-Context Adapter Generation for Compositional Generalization in Large Audio Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34413v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) have achieved strong performance on standard speech and audio understanding tasks, yet their ability to systematically generalize to novel task compositions remains underexplored. Taking a meta-learning view, we extend Text-to-LoRA (T2L) to LALMs, generating instruction-conditioned LoRA adapters with a Transformer hypernetwork rather than learning a single fixed adapter shared across instructions. To exploit fine-grained task information, we introduce in-context adapter generation (ICAG), a token-level hypernetwork architecture; we call the resulting method T2L-ICAG. We evaluate this approach on two representative LALMs using SIFT-50M for supervised fine-tuning and construct a controlled compositional evaluation suite covering five task classes. Across two LALM backbones, T2L-ICAG consistently improves over static LoRA and also the global embedding-based T2L baseline. Coverage and capacity analyses f

translated_title: 面向大型音频语言模型组合泛化的上下文适配器生成
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在标准语音和音频理解任务上已取得强劲表现，但其系统性地泛化到新任务组合的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们从元学习的视角出发，将 Text-to-LoRA（T2L）扩展到 LALMs，利用 Transformer 超网络生成以指令为条件的 LoRA 适配器，而不是学习一个在所有指令间共享的单一固定适配器。为了充分利用细粒度的任务信息，我们提出了上下文适配器生成（ICAG），这是一种 token 级别的超网络架构，我们将由此得到的方法称为 T2L-ICAG。我们在两个代表性的 LALMs 上评估了该方法，使用 SIFT-50M 进行监督微调，并构建了一个涵盖五类任务的受控组合评估套件。在两个 LALM 骨干模型上，T2L-ICAG 均持续优于静态 LoRA 以及基于全局嵌入的 T2L 基线。覆盖率和容量分析进一步……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出 T2L-ICAG 方法，通过 token 级超网络为大型音频语言模型生成指令条件化的 LoRA 适配器，从而显著提升模型对新任务组合的系统性泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes T2L-ICAG, a token-level hypernetwork that generates instruction-conditioned LoRA adapters for large audio language models, consistently improving compositional generalization over static LoRA and global-embedding T2L baselines.
